name: tides_organizations_latest
title: tides_organizations_latest
description:
Current-version cut of tides_organizations (`WHERE _is_current`).
Exported to the TIDES bucket at a stable path as the latest
organization reference snapshot.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Synthetic version surrogate; unique per organization version.

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description:
Airtable source record ID of the organization. Join key from the
TIDES facts' `organization_source_record_id`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Organization name.

fields.name: organization_type
fields.description: Type of organization (e.g. city/town, county, independent agency, JPA).

fields.name: website
fields.description: Organization website URL.

fields.name: is_public_entity
fields.description: Whether the organization is a public entity.

fields.name: ntd_id
fields.description: National Transit Database ID of the organization.

fields.name: ntd_agency_info_key
fields.description: Key to NTD agency information for this organization.

fields.name: ntd_id_2022
fields.description: 2022-era National Transit Database ID, where it differs from `ntd_id`.

fields.name: rtpa_key
fields.description: Key of the Regional Transportation Planning Agency this organization belongs to.

fields.name: rtpa_name
fields.description: Name of the Regional Transportation Planning Agency this organization belongs to.

fields.name: mpo_key
fields.description: Key of the Metropolitan Planning Organization this organization belongs to.

fields.name: mpo_name
fields.description: Name of the Metropolitan Planning Organization this organization belongs to.

fields.name: public_currently_operating
fields.description: Whether the organization currently operates public transit service.

fields.name: public_currently_operating_fixed_route
fields.description: Whether the organization currently operates public fixed-route transit service.

fields.name: caltrans_district
fields.description: Caltrans district number of the organization's headquarters county.

fields.name: caltrans_district_name
fields.description: Caltrans district name of the organization's headquarters county.

fields.name: _valid_from
fields.description: Timestamp from which this record version is valid (inclusive).

fields.name: _valid_to
fields.description: Timestamp until which this record version is valid.

fields.name: _is_current
fields.description: Whether this is the current version of the record.
